from pathlib import Path
import cv2
import numpy as np
import subprocess

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
out=root/'renders/recreated.mp4'
cmd=['ffmpeg','-y','-v','warning','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-s','640x360','-r','24000/1001','-i','pipe:0','-an','-c:v','libx264','-preset','slow','-crf','17','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-color_primaries','bt709','-color_trc','bt709','-colorspace','bt709','-movflags','+faststart',str(out)]
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
rng=np.random.default_rng(8290)
yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:360,0:640]
vignette=(1-.15*((xx-320)/400)**2-.06*((yy-175)/240)**2).astype(np.float32)
for i in range(288):
    frame=cv2.imread(str(root/f'renders/frames/{i:04d}.png'))
    if frame is None: raise RuntimeError(f'Missing frame {i}')
    frame=cv2.resize(frame,(640,360),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    a=cv2.cvtColor(frame,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB).astype(np.float32)/255.
    # Light diffusion in the lens, calculated solely from rendered red lamps.
    red=np.clip(a[:,:,0]-np.maximum(a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2])*1.7,0,1)
    red*=np.clip((a[:,:,0]-.30)*3,0,1)
    halo=.42*cv2.GaussianBlur(red,(0,0),1.7)+.52*cv2.GaussianBlur(red,(0,0),5)+.30*cv2.GaussianBlur(red,(0,0),11)
    glow=np.stack([halo,halo*.012,halo*.045],axis=-1)
    a=1-(1-a)*(1-glow)
    a=cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),.26)
    a*=vignette[:,:,None]
    grain=rng.normal(0,.0018,(360,640,1)).astype(np.float32)*np.minimum(a.mean(2,keepdims=True)*15,1)
    a=np.clip((a+grain)*255,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    p.stdin.write(a.tobytes())
    if i in [0,84,144,168,204,228,276]:cv2.imwrite(str(root/f'analysis/final_{i:03d}.jpg'),cv2.cvtColor(a,cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR))
p.stdin.close()
if p.wait()"'!=0: raise RuntimeError('"'ffmpeg failed')
print(out)
